description:
AI-native developer terminal built on Tauri and Rust

Gear is a fast, lightweight developer terminal built on Tauri and Rust. It combines a native PTY backend with an integrated AI assistant, code editor, file explorer, and source control panel.
0.1.6 (2026-10-12)
Features
- editor: minimap (Settings → Features, or 'Toggle minimap') — a zoomed-out strip of the file with a slider over the visible part; click or drag to scroll. Also 'Window: Toggle always on top' (bb780d7)
- github: pull requests, workflow runs and issues from the palette via the gh CLI — check out / diff / checks / merge a PR, read a failed run's log, re-run, watch or cancel it, start a branch for an issue (3d721d5)
- terminal: inline images — Sixel and the iTerm2 image protocol (img2sixel, chafa, imgcat, plotting libraries) via the xterm image addon; Settings → Features → Inline images (a4f5c56)
- window: global show / hide hotkey — a system-wide key combination brings Gear forward from any app, or hides it when it is already in front (drop-down terminal). Settings → Features, or 'Window: Set the global show / hide hotkey…' (9260ab7)
Bug Fixes
- editor: opening a file at a line works when the file was not open yet — the jump ran before the editor view existed and was dropped; also py-spy follows child processes so a Windows virtualenv's launcher can be profiled (c6afa69)
- editor: sticky scroll works again and the rainbow toggles apply at once — sticky scroll read the layout during an editor update, which crashed its plugin; the bracket and indent colours waited for the next keystroke (a9fc40c)
- editor: text commands no longer edit a hidden tab — with a Markdown preview or another non-editor tab in front they changed the last-used file out of sight; they now say to switch to the editor tab (7d3d2b5)
- git: 'Apply patch from clipboard' accepts clipboard text with Windows line endings (9f05462)
- github: strip the caret-notation colour codes gh writes into piped run logs (5492d82)
- git: quote arguments that contain a comma — PowerShell split 'log -L5,9:file' in two, so 'History of the selected lines' always failed on Windows (2b692c5)
- git: stage / unstage / discard selected lines on files with Windows line endings — the saved-file check compared \r\n text with the editor's \n text and always said 'Save the file first' (898d749)
- git: the file diff shows changes for files with Windows line endings — the view was fed text with \r\n, kept replacing its own document and drew no change or hunk button (f452383)
- logview: opening a log file crashed the editor area — the pane gave the tab host a new handle on every render, which re-rendered it without end; the handle now keeps its identity (cf30086)
- palette: file search always said 'Could not search workspace' — read the hits out of the search result instead of treating the result as the list (97b8bf8)
- publish: a Release started by hand never publishes packages on its own — a test build dispatched from main re-published the latest stable release (b3aadda)
- publish: winget needs the workflow scope on WINGET_TOKEN — check for it up front and fail the fork sync with that message instead of komac's misleading UpdateRef error (6f69ec5)
- security: the secret scan skips virtualenv and site-packages folders (4b384d8)
- terminal: 'Activate project toolchain' finds .venv, .nvmrc, .node-version and .tool-versions — its folder listing left out names starting with a dot; task and .gitignore detection use the full listing too (572502b)
- terminal: 'Show environment variables' on Windows — 'set' is Set-Variable in PowerShell, so list the environment through cmd (bd58ecf)
- terminal: 'Tail the active file' follows the log in front instead of the last edited file, and 'Serve a folder' finds Python and Node on Windows (06ba605)
- terminal: jumping to a problem lands on the reported column, not the start of the line — the column is carried through the open-file path and clamped to the line (3133ef4)
- terminal: report failed PowerShell commands as failed — an unknown command or failing cmdlet inherited the last program's exit code 0, so typo correction and failure marks never fired (057acce)
- ui: Dependencies says when a folder has no manifest instead of 'Looking for…' forever, and Processes says it is reading instead of 'Nothing is listening' while the first sample loads (36d06c7)
- windows: commands that chained with && now run in Windows PowerShell 5.1 — version bump commit and tag, split last commit, and the sync-with-upstream workflow (ab9382f)
